text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Huh...? Wait a sec...? Huh huh huh huh...?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: I managed to reach the goal. I did, but...

"The race performance wasn't much to 
praise. Results aside, the pace and other 
factors strayed considerably from the 
plan."

For someone as precise as Transcend, this 
race certainly went off-script...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
No, I don't know... Or rather, it's not 
that I don't know...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
There's "nothing," you know. Almost no 
memory of when I was running...
choice_data_list: Huh, you don't remember anything at all?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah... I remember everything up until 
right after the start, but..."
(WOOAAAH...!)

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Go, Transcend!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Show me that amazing running everyone's 
talking about!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: (E-Ehh... A-Auugh...)

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"The moment I heard cheers I'd never heard 
before, I completely lost my head. And 
then..."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: (Uwooooaaagh!)

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Before I knew it, I had crossed the finish 
line... This is...
choice_data_list:
I see, it’s because you’ve never gotten 
this much attention before…

text_block_list.text:
It seemed what threw off Transcend's 
senses was the passionate gaze of the race 
fans.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Attention... I see. I've never really 
been the center of attention much before, 
so..."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
So that's why your mind completely blanked 
out from the overflow, huh...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, honestly, this is a pretty big 
problem~ What should we do, Trai-chan?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
It'd be nice if it were a pleasant 
surprise, but to think I wouldn't be able 
to run the way I wanted...
choice_data_list:
Well... I suppose that sort of thing can 
happen...

Well... that sort of thing could happen, 
right...?

text_block_list.text:
I had hoped things would go my way, but I 
was naive. As expected, things never go as 
smoothly as planned on paper.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
What should I do? At this rate, there's no 
way I'll get to experience the thrill that 
lies beyond going all out...

The challenge is getting used to being in 
the spotlight. In that case, there's only 
one thing to do—
choice_data_list:
I just need to get more experience under 
my belt.
I just need to get more experience, huh.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Experience...? Do you mean running in lots 
of races?
choice_data_list:
Yeah, and let's get used to being the lead 
role.

Yeah, and let's get used to being the star 
of the show.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Gwah, the lead role... Experience aside, 
can someone really get used to being the 
star?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"No matter how much sunlight you shine on 
a night-blooming jasmine, I don't think 
it'll turn into a sunflower."
choice_data_list:
A sudden mutation might actually be pretty 
likely, you know.

A sudden mutation might be surprisingly 
likely.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, look at you talking big... Well, if 
Trainy says so, maybe I'll give it a shot.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Even if my personality won't change, I 
still gotta expand my heart's capacity. So 
Trainie, I'm counting on you for the 
upgrade!

I accept with a smile. For now, I'll enter 
her in various races while helping her get 
used to being the center of attention in 
her personal life as well.
